reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly describes the same end-time overlap in AuctionDemo where claimAuction (>= endTime) and cancelBid/cancelAllBids (<= endTime) are both callable at block.timestamp == endTime, and that claimAuction refunds without setting status=false. It further notes reentrancy/callback possibilities and that a bidder (including the winner) can then call cancelBid to receive the same bid again, draining pooled ETH and potentially getting the NFT for free. This is the same code path (AuctionDemo.claimAuction + cancelBid/cancelAllBids), same root cause (overlapping time checks plus missing status reset on claimAuction refunds), same attack and impact (double refund/drain), and would be fixed by the same remedies (tighten the time check and set status=false before refunding).
